run_pipeline_full: run the full capture transfer, merge, and post-processing pipeline for a named dataset
run_pipeline_skip_transfer: run the merge and post-processing pipeline steps while skipping the camera transfer step
run_pipeline_delete_capture: run the full pipeline and delete capture folders after the merge step completes
run_pipeline_cli: run the pipeline from the command line with a dataset name and optional flags
review_run_pipeline: review the run_pipeline function that orchestrates capture transfer, merge, and post-processing
